title: GeoPT: Scaling Physics Simulation via Lifted Geometric Pre-Training
claim: Our dynamics-aware pre-training beats scratch and geometry-only baselines, cutting needed data and training time while naive pre-training hurts.
layout: 3 panels: large 3D surface left, two stacked line plots right
description: A shared legend runs across the top with four colored entries: From Scratch (gray), Geometry-Only Pre-Training (green), Geometry-Only Conditioning (blue), and GeoPT (pink). On the left, a large 3D plot shows four translucent colored surfaces of Relative L2 error. The axes are training epochs and training samples, and a small rendered car with flow streamlines sits in the upper corner. The pink GeoPT surface lies lowest, and the green surface lies highest. On the right, two stacked 2D line plots slice the surface. The top plot fixes 100 samples and varies epochs. The bottom plot fixes 200 epochs and varies samples. Bold red annotations read '2x Faster Converging' and '40% Data Saving', and a dashed horizontal reference line marks the baseline error. The pink GeoPT curve is lowest in both plots.
caption: Neural aerodynamics simulation on DrivAerML [ref] based on Transolver [ref] backbone. Geometry-only pre-training and conditioning refer to pre-training by predicting vector distance [ref] of given positions and utilizing geometry representation extracted by Hunyuan3D [ref] as auxiliary feature, respectively.
abstract: Neural simulators promise efficient surrogates for physics simulation, but scaling them is bottlenecked by the prohibitive cost of generating high-fidelity training data. Pre-training on abundant off-the-shelf geometries offers a natural alternative, yet faces a fundamental gap: supervision on static geometry alone ignores dynamics and can lead to negative transfer on physics tasks. We present GeoPT, a unified pre-trained model for general physics simulation based on lifted geometric pre-training. The core idea is to augment geometry with synthetic dynamics, enabling dynamics-aware self-supervision without physics labels. Pre-trained on over one million samples, GeoPT consistently improves industrial-fidelity benchmarks spanning fluid mechanics for cars, aircraft, and ships, and solid mechanics in crash simulation, reducing labeled data requirements by 20-60% and accelerating convergence by 2$\times$. These results show that lifting with synthetic dynamics bridges the geometry-physics gap, unlocking a scalable path for neural simulation and potentially beyond. Code is available at https://github.com/Physics-Scaling/GeoPT.
